# NCNN Android Vulkan SDK

This directory contains the `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86`, and
`x86_64` directories from Tencent NCNN's official
`ncnn-20260526-android-vulkan.zip` prebuilt release:

https://github.com/Tencent/ncnn/releases/tag/20260526

The unused RISC-V ABI and the redundant downloaded ZIP are not included.
No model weights are part of this dependency.

NCNN and the included third-party components remain governed by the terms in
[LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
